channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, AI, Tech & Research, Europe, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, AI, Tech & Research, Europe, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Jane Street Graduate Research Fellowship 2027 (tuition plus USD 50,000 stipend) (closes 13 Nov)
item.description:
Jane Street
Deadline: 13 Nov 2026
Award: Full tuition and fees for the award year plus a USD 50,000 stipend (or local-currency equivalent; taxable). Finalists receive USD 5,000. No application fee.

Jane Street's Graduate Research Fellowship supports exceptional doctoral students in electrical engineering and computer science, mathematics, physics or statistics; research does not need to relate to trading.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Leibniz Summer Fellowships 2027 (ZZF Potsdam, contemporary history)
item.description: Leibniz Centre for Contemporary History Potsdam (ZZF) · deadline 30 Nov 2026 · Two fellowships of EUR 3,000 per month for two months (EUR 6,000 total each), plus office space, computer facilities, specialist library access and participation in ZZF's academic community. No application fee.

item.title: KU Leuven AI Safety Lab: Visiting Fellowships 2027 (Leuven)
item.description: KU Leuven AI Safety Lab · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · EUR 2,000 per month for three months, covering accommodation and living costs, plus office space, library access and KU Leuven facilities. Five fellowships. No application fee.

item.title: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study Fellowships 2027/28 (Lisbon)
item.description: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study (GIAS), Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Up to 15 fellowships a year. Each covers travel costs, travel and health insurance, a monthly stipend and a partial housing subsidy; the stipend level is set at selection based on CV and length of stay. No application fee.
